meta.title: Regretted item is crossed out in the buyer's QCS
gaps: Directly assert that the regretted QCS line item is visually struck through.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert that the regretted QCS line item is visually struck through.

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for vendor bidding and QCS inspection.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the event's pricing round and bid sheet as the vendor.
Open the vendor's Quick Fill actions.
Mark the target line item as regretted.
Submit the vendor response containing the regretted item.
Confirm the vendor submission was accepted.
Open the buyer's quote comparison sheet.
Confirm the QCS exposes the regretted state for the line item, as the closest available observation to the required strikethrough.
